pubcol-w-2f6c423b8822f6bc.definition_en: to keep some money aside for a time when it may be needed unexpectedly
collocations: always save for a rainy day
wisely save for a rainy day
saving something for a rainy day
pubcol-w-2f6c423b8822f6bc.example_simple: My grandmother taught me to save for a rainy day.
pubcol-w-2f6c423b8822f6bc.example_complex: Rather than spending every bonus, she chose to save for a rainy day, knowing that unexpected expenses could arise at any time.

pubcol-w-a440a94d5d1233f6.example_simple: I prefer savoury food to sweet desserts.
pubcol-w-a440a94d5d1233f6.example_complex: The buffet offered a tempting range of savoury pastries alongside the sugary treats.

pubcol-w-46cde58f48d57e54.definition_en: to tell someone that you are leaving or parting from them
pubcol-w-46cde58f48d57e54.example_simple: I waved to say goodbye to my classmates.
pubcol-w-46cde58f48d57e54.example_complex: Before boarding the train, she paused to say goodbye to her family, promising to write every week.

pubcol-w-1be944b2a4b7b371.definition_en: to greet someone when you meet or contact them
pubcol-w-1be944b2a4b7b371.example_simple: Come in and say hello to everyone.
pubcol-w-1be944b2a4b7b371.example_complex: Whenever he visits the office, he makes a point of stopping by each desk to say hello to his old colleagues.

pubcol-w-38dd7ff6c486fb68.definition_en: to say something inappropriate or hurtful, often by accident
collocations: afraid of saying the wrong thing
say the wrong thing at the wrong time
pubcol-w-38dd7ff6c486fb68.example_simple: I'm worried I'll say the wrong thing at the interview.
pubcol-w-38dd7ff6c486fb68.example_complex: In such a tense meeting, one careless remark can say the wrong thing and undo weeks of careful diplomacy.

pubcol-w-97ed7f6f63625df0.example_simple: The squirrels scamper up the tree when I come near.
pubcol-w-97ed7f6f63625df0.example_complex: At the first clap of thunder, the puppies scampered under the sofa and refused to come out.
pubcol-w-97ed7f6f63625df0.vi_meaning_correction: chạy tung tăng, chạy vụt (bằng những bước nhanh và ngắn)

f4e4d431-e4c0-4276-b121-871492d780ef.definition_en: a person who is blamed for the wrongdoings or mistakes of others

pubcol-w-503ab04b1b198278.example_simple: The scarcity of clean water is a serious problem in the region.
pubcol-w-503ab04b1b198278.example_complex: The looming scarcity of skilled workers has forced many firms to invest heavily in training programmes.

pubcol-w-34305c61a64c3c5c.definition_en: feeling frightened or afraid of something
pubcol-w-34305c61a64c3c5c.example_simple: I was scared of the dark when I was a child.
pubcol-w-34305c61a64c3c5c.example_complex: Although she looked calm on stage, she later admitted she had been absolutely scared of forgetting her lines.

pubcol-w-a384cff1a3694293.definition_en: a piece of cloth worn around the neck, head or shoulders for warmth or decoration
pubcol-w-a384cff1a3694293.example_simple: She wrapped a warm scarf around her neck before going out.
pubcol-w-a384cff1a3694293.example_complex: He gave her a hand-knitted scarf, its bright colours a welcome contrast to the grey winter streets.

pubcol-w-9e408b030ac55fc8.definition_en: extremely harsh and severe criticism of something
pubcol-w-9e408b030ac55fc8.example_simple: The report faced scathing criticism from the public.
pubcol-w-9e408b030ac55fc8.example_complex: The minister's proposal drew scathing criticisms of its cost and feasibility from economists across the political spectrum.

pubcol-w-3a1e3fa7afed17e3.definition_en: the natural features of a landscape considered in terms of their appearance
pubcol-w-3a1e3fa7afed17e3.example_simple: The scenery along the coast is breathtaking.
pubcol-w-3a1e3fa7afed17e3.example_complex: As the train wound through the valley, passengers fell silent, absorbed by the dramatic mountain scenery.

pubcol-w-631a56a01b047624.definition_en: planned repair or servicing work carried out at regular, arranged times
pubcol-w-631a56a01b047624.example_simple: The website is offline for scheduled maintenance.
pubcol-w-631a56a01b047624.example_complex: The airline grounded the aircraft for scheduled maintenance, ensuring every component met strict safety standards before the next flight.

pubcol-w-89accb9779ed58ec.definition_en: a regular, arranged market where second-hand and cheap goods are bought and sold
pubcol-w-89accb9779ed58ec.example_simple: We found an old lamp at the flea market on Sunday.
pubcol-w-89accb9779ed58ec.example_complex: During the scheduled trading session, the flea market buzzed with dealers haggling over vintage furniture and rare records.

pubcol-w-655f83be7512e5b5.definition_en: an institution where children or students are taught
pubcol-w-655f83be7512e5b5.example_simple: My little brother goes to a public school near our house.
pubcol-w-655f83be7512e5b5.example_complex: The debate over whether independent schools offer a genuine advantage over state schools continues to divide educators.

pubcol-w-db306f958b6315b8.definition_en: an official document recording a student's academic results and progress at school
pubcol-w-db306f958b6315b8.example_simple: You need your school certificate to apply for university.
pubcol-w-db306f958b6315b8.example_complex: Applicants were asked to submit a certified copy of their school certificate along with their personal statement.

pubcol-w-78efb1f71de4482b.example_simple: He gave me an angry scowl when I interrupted him.
pubcol-w-78efb1f71de4482b.example_complex: She scowled at the referee's decision, folding her arms in silent protest.

8f9cf6f8-9e61-43f4-bef4-3e4b9544a6a9.definition_en: to move or climb quickly using your hands and feet, or to struggle to do something urgently

pubcol-w-15ab0ffc4109e659.definition_en: to cry out loudly because of sudden fear
pubcol-w-15ab0ffc4109e659.example_simple: The children screamed in panic when the lights went out.
pubcol-w-15ab0ffc4109e659.example_complex: As smoke filled the corridor, passengers began to scream in panic and rush toward the emergency exits.

pubcol-w-768d5b4346788d8f.example_simple: I heard the screech of tyres before the crash.
pubcol-w-768d5b4346788d8f.example_complex: The car came to a stop with a piercing screech that echoed down the empty street.

5afa1fa2-dbd2-4854-8193-f881216cbd83.definition_en: a mistake made by a copyist when hand-copying a text

5ef07886-be6d-4f61-bb6d-6e317ace42e1.definition_en: a person who copied documents by hand before printing was invented

pubcol-w-c7a437d330756522.definition_en: to live very economically in order to save money
pubcol-w-c7a437d330756522.example_simple: They had to scrimp and save to buy their first home.
pubcol-w-c7a437d330756522.example_complex: For a decade the couple scrimped and saved, forgoing holidays and luxuries so their children could attend university.
